metas.name: Signal One
metas.description: It tells the story of a computer scientist who is recruited by a tech billionaire to work on a project that could change humanity's place in the universe.

metas.name: The Marked Woman
metas.description: An unconscious woman is found in a Barcelona dock container. She awakens with no memory, and an attempt is made on her life in the hospital. Inspectors Ripoll and Zapori investigate the mysterious case.

metas.name: Office Romance
metas.description: Jackie, President and CEO of Air Cruz, runs a tight ship in her business, including a rigid anti-fraternization policy for all her employees. When a new sexy lawyer begins working for her, that policy becomes very tested.

metas.name: Scary Movie
metas.description: Two friends find themselves caught up in mayhem involving killers, monsters and supernatural creatures once again.

metas.name: Poldi
metas.description: Footballer, entrepreneur, fan favorite and true community hero — Lukas Podolski reflects on his journey and what comes next in this intimate documentary.

metas.name: De Gaulle: Résistance
metas.description: A powerful account of Charles de Gaulle's journey during World War II, from his rise as a military leader to his emergence in French politics between 1940-1945.

metas.name: Instadocs: Alex Murdaugh, Unconvicted
metas.description: Why was Alex Murdaugh's conviction overturned? The debut of "Instadocs" digs into stunning allegations of jury interference in his double murder trial.

metas.name: Backrooms
metas.description: Clark, an angry architect, chases the source of impossible power failures when a glowing gap opens in his basement, but the yellow maze beyond it threatens his sanity, his friends, and Mary.

metas.name: Pressure
metas.description: In the tense 72 hours before D-Day, General Dwight D. Eisenhower and Captain James Stagg face an impossible choice--launch the most dangerous seaborne invasion in history or risk losing the war altogether.

metas.name: Tuner
metas.description: A talented piano tuner who suffers from hyperacusis discovers an unexpected aptitude for cracking safes, turning his life upside down.

metas.name: The Breadwinner
metas.description: When a supermom lands a Shark Tank deal, she switches roles with her breadwinner husband, who struggles to adapt as a stay-at-home dad to their three daughters.

metas.name: Propeller One-Way Night Coach
metas.description: Based on Travolta's 1997 book. Follows young aviation enthusiast Jeff and his mother on a cross-country flight to Hollywood that transforms into a life-changing journey filled with unexpected moments.

metas.name: Mononoke the Movie: Chapter III - The Curse of the Serpent
metas.description: When tragedy strikes within the walls of the Ōoku, twisted human passions and festering grudges spawn the Medicine Seller's most fearsome opponent yet.

metas.name: Time and Water
metas.description: Facing the death of his country’s glaciers and the loss of his beloved grandparents, Icelandic writer Andri Snær Magnason turns his archives into a time capsule to hold what is slipping away — family, memory, time, and water.

metas.name: Marshmallow
metas.description: When a once-fabled campfire tale becomes real, a group of campers uncover a profound secret that questions their very existence.

metas.name: Untold UK: Vinnie Jones
metas.description: How the bad boy of English football became a Hollywood tough guy.

metas.name: Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu
metas.description: Once a lone bounty hunter, Mandalorian Din Djarin and his apprentice Grogu embark on an exciting new Star Wars adventure.

metas.name: Ladies First
metas.description: A male chauvinist is transported to a matriarchal society, facing challenges from a formidable female version of himself.

metas.name: Passenger
metas.description: After a young couple witnesses a gruesome highway accident, they soon realize they did not leave the crash scene alone, as a demonic presence called the Passenger won't stop until it claims them both.

metas.name: Colony
metas.description: Professor Se Jeong attends a biotech conference, only to witness it spiral into catastrophe when a rapidly mutating virus is unleashed. As the outbreak spreads and the infected begin to transform, authorities seal off the entire f...

metas.name: Tom Clancy's Jack Ryan: Ghost War
metas.description: Follows Jack Ryan who reunites with CIA operatives to navigate a treacherous web of betrayal against an enemy who knows their every move, facing a past they thought was long put to rest.

metas.name: Untold UK: Liverpool's Miracle of Istanbul
metas.description: At half-time in the 2005 champion league final Liverpool were 3-0 down. What happened next made football history -​ as players recall in this documentary.

metas.name: Obsession
metas.description: After breaking the mysterious "One Wish Willow" to win his crush's heart, a hopeless romantic finds himself getting exactly what he asked for but soon discovers that some desires come at a dark, sinister price.

metas.name: In the Grey
metas.description: A covert team of elite operatives are living in the shadows. When a ruthless despot steals a billion-dollar fortune, they're sent to steal it back--an impossible heist that erupts into a deadly game of strategy, deception and surv...

metas.name: Driver's Ed
metas.description: A group of teens who steal their school's driver's ed car to go on a road trip to help a high school senior track down his college-freshman girlfriend and win her back.

metas.name: The Crash
metas.description: Follows the Mackenzie Shirilla case, a 17-year-old who intentionally crashed her car into a brick wall in Ohio, killing her boyfriend Dominic Russo and his friend Davion Flanagan.

metas.name: The Christophers
metas.description: The children of a once famous artist hire a forger to complete some unfinished, long ago abandoned canvases so they'll have an inheritance when he dies.

metas.name: Kartavya
metas.description: A police officer must hunt an exploited teenage assassin while his own family collapses under caste driven violence and moral absolutism, forcing him toward irreversible choices between institutional loyalty and blood ties.

metas.name: Lisa Ann Walter: It Was an Accident
metas.description: Lisa Ann Walter's long-awaited debut comedy special takes on feral Gen-Xers, self-loathing, and navigating a backsliding America, via the no-filter lens of a grown-ass woman who has been paying attention.

metas.name: The Bus: A French Football Mutiny
metas.description: This documentary revisits the controversy surrounding the French team during the 2010 FIFA World Cup and the strike that made headlines and outraged an entire country.

metas.name: The Punisher: One Last Kill
metas.description: As Frank Castle searches for meaning beyond revenge, an unexpected force pulls him back into the fight.

metas.name: Marty, Life Is Short
metas.description: Follows the definitive documentary on comedian Martin Short, exploring his career across film, television, theater and comedy.

metas.name: The Sheep Detectives
metas.description: Every night a shepherd reads aloud a murder mystery, pretending his sheep can understand. When he is found dead, the sheep realize at once that it was a murder and think they know everything about how to go about solving it.

metas.name: Remarkably Bright Creatures
metas.description: Through unlikely bonds formed during night shifts at a local aquarium, Tova, an elderly widow, learns of a life-changing discovery that may bring her joy and wonder once again.

metas.name: Mortal Kombat II
metas.description: The fan favorite champions -- now joined by Johnny Cage himself -- are pitted against one another in the ultimate battle to defeat the dark rule of Shao Kahn that threatens the very existence of the Earthrealm and its defenders.

metas.name: Iron Maiden: Burning Ambition
metas.description: Spanning five decades, Iron Maiden: Burning Ambition charts their iconic rise to become one of the biggest bands in music history.

metas.name: Billie Eilish: Hit Me Hard and Soft
metas.description: An accompanying 3D concert film, documenting the Manchester shows and co-directed by Eilish and James Cameron.

metas.name: No Place to Be Single
metas.description: In a picturesque Tuscan town, Elisa's world shifts when a childhood friend's return stirs up old emotions.

metas.name: Desire
metas.description: Lucero lo tiene todo, pero un vacío la empuja al riesgo. Matías, el atractivo entrenador de natación, despierta en ella una obsesión: una relación que amenaza su mundo cuando su hija también se siente atraída por él.

metas.name: My Dearest Assassin
metas.description: Hunted for her rare blood type, a caged woman vows to fight alongside the assassin she loves to protect their future when an old enemy resurfaces.

metas.name: Hokum
metas.description: A horror writer visits an Irish inn to scatter his parents' ashes, unaware the property is said to be haunted by a witch.

metas.name: The Devil Wears Prada 2
metas.description: Andy Sachs reunites with Miranda Priestly as they navigate their careers amid the decline of traditional magazine publishing.

metas.name: Swapped
metas.description: A tiny woodland creature and a majestic bird suddenly swap bodies, forcing them to team up to survive the wildest adventure of their lives.

metas.name: Deep Water
metas.description: A group of international passengers en route from Los Angeles to Shanghai are forced to make an emergency landing in shark-infested waters. Now they must work together in hopes to overcome the frenzy of sharks drawn to the wreckage.

metas.name: My Dearest Señorita
metas.description: A young woman's medical discovery challenges everything she knows about herself, leading her on an unexpected path toward self-acceptance and a love that defies convention.

metas.name: Michael
metas.description: The early life of musician Michael Jackson, from the discovery of his talent as the lead of the Jackson Five to the artist whose creative ambition fueled a pursuit to become the biggest entertainer in the world.

metas.name: I Swear
metas.description: John Davidson: diagnosed with Tourette's syndrome at a young age which alienated him from his peers, he struggled with a condition few people had witnessed.

metas.name: Fuze
metas.description: An unexploded WWII bomb is discovered on a busy construction site in the centre of London. Chaos ensues as the military and police begin a mass evacuation against a ticking clock.

metas.name: Apex
metas.description: A mountain climber haunted by a fatal decision in Norway retreats to the Australian wilderness for isolation. Her journey turns into a desperate hunt when a deceptive local targets her as his next ritualistic prey in the bush.

metas.name: Over Your Dead Body
metas.description: A dysfunctional married couple retreats to a secluded cabin to repair their relationship, but each secretly plots to murder the other.

metas.name: Desert Warrior
metas.description: An honorable and mysterious rogue, known as Hanzala, makes himself an enemy of the Emperor Kisra after he helps a fugitive king and princess in the desert.

metas.name: Mother Mary
metas.description: Long-buried wounds rise to the surface when iconic pop star Mother Mary reunites with her estranged best friend and former costume designer, Sam Anselm, on the eve of her comeback performance.

metas.name: Amrum
metas.description: In 1945 Amrum Island, 12-year-old Nanning hunts seals, fishes at night, and farms to help feed his family. Life feels idyllic on this windswept isle until peace reveals an unexpected danger closer to home.

metas.name: The Doll
metas.description: Eastern France, nowadays.  Rémi, who has never recovered from a heartbreak, shares his life with a doll called Audrey. But the day his new coworker, Patricia, arrives at his company, Audrey comes to life. The two women will turn Rémi’s life upside down.

metas.name: Orangutan
metas.description: Narrated by Josh Gad, journey high into the rainforest canopy of Southeast Asia where a magnificent and mysterious community filled with playful personalities lives. Witness the exhilarating action, heartwarming encounters, and a closeup look at a stunning jungle teeming with wildlife as the inquisitive adolescent orangutan Indah prepares to leave her family and venture out on her own for the firs

metas.name: Son-in-Law
metas.description: José Sánchez has big ambitions, terrible instincts, and a mustache to match. After a string of bad deals, he accidentally bluffs his way into becoming El Serpiente, a political boss feared for all the wrong reasons. Now he must pull off one final deal to stay alive — a deal far beyond anything he can fake.

metas.name: Lee Cronin's The Mummy
metas.description: Eight years after her sudden disappearance in Egypt, a severely traumatized teenager is returned to her shattered family in New Mexico, triggering a visceral nightmare as they realize she is hosting an ancient, demonic parasite.

metas.name: Normal
metas.description: Centers on a temporary small-town sheriff who uncovers dark mysteries after a local bank robbery.

metas.name: A Gorilla Story: Told by David Attenborough
metas.description: David Attenborough tells the remarkable story of his first encounter with the baby gorilla Pablo, how that gorilla grew up to be a top Silverback and how Pablo's direct descendants are doing today.
When an unexpected road rage incident puts his son in critical condition, an enraged father spirals down a dark path of emotional turmoil and vengeance.

metas.name: Roommates
metas.description: When a hopeful, naive college freshman, Devon, asks the cool and confident Celeste to be her roommate, a blossoming friendship spirals into a war of passive aggression.

metas.name: Ballistic
metas.description: A mother who works for an ammunition manufacturing company finds out she made the bullet that killed her son.

metas.name: Ghost in the Cell
metas.description: A notorious prison, an invisible force starts killing inmates brutally, compelling enemy gangs and corrupt guards to work together as they try to survive the mounting bloodshed.

metas.name: Je M'appelle Agneta
metas.description: Agneta, 49, is vibrant but seems invisible. Her kids have left home, her traffic office job is stuck, and she feels unseen. Meanwhile, her husband has found purpose through cold plunges and pricey cycling gear.

metas.name: Balls Up
metas.description: Two marketers pitch a bold new condom World Cup sponsorship. After a booze-fueled scandal, they must outrun chaos to survive.

metas.name: Toaster
metas.description: Murder and chaos erupt when a miser becomes obsessed with a toaster he gave as a wedding gift.

metas.name: Storm Rider: Legend of Hammerhead
metas.description: 300 years after the Big Flood, the legend of an outlawed Storm Rider inspires two rebellious islanders to find out the truth about the origin of their world.

metas.name: #Skyking
metas.description: A troubled airport worker's impulsive decision to steal and fly a commercial plane becomes a gripping aerial drama that reflects deeper issues of mental health and working-class struggles in America.

metas.name: Trevor Noah: Joy in the Trenches
metas.description: From unexpected social media beef to a therapist's truth bomb, Trevor Noah turns chaos into comedy in this hilariously sharp, playful stand-up set.

metas.name: Thrash
metas.description: When a Category 5 hurricane decimates a coastal town, the storm surge brings devastation, chaos and something far more frightening: hungry sharks.

metas.name: Outcome
metas.description: Hollywood star Reef is forced to confront his problems and atone for his past after being threatened by bizarre video footage from his past.

metas.name: Boulevard
metas.description: Two high school outcasts find unexpected connection despite their personal demons. As Halsey battles addiction and Luke confronts his own darkness, their growing feelings force them to question if love is worth the risk.

metas.name: 18th Rose
metas.description: A spirited teen dreaming of the perfect debut makes a deal with a lonely newcomer, but unexpected feelings and revelations may shatter their plans.

metas.name: Sniper: No Nation
metas.description: כאשר הצלף המומחה אייס ברנדון בקט מואשם כטרוריסט ומודח על ידי מדינתו, הוא נאלץ להיעלם מהרדאר ולצאת למשימת הצלה בלתי אפשרית לצד אביו האגדי. ללא תמיכה, ללא גבולות וללא חוקים, עליהם להתמודד עם לגיון הברזל, צבא שכירי חרב חסר רחמים, כדי לעצור משטר מושחת מלהצית מלחמה - ולהוכיח שגם ללא דגל, הקרב עדיין חשוב.

metas.name: Finding Harry: The Craft Behind the Magic
metas.description: An inside look at the epic scale and meticulous care behind Harry Potter (2026).

metas.name: The Drama
metas.description: A happily-engaged couple is put to the test when an unexpected turn sends their wedding week off the rails.

metas.name: S4: The Bob Lazar Story
metas.description: From jet engines to Los Alamos, Bob Lazar's life is rooted in science. In 1988, hired at S4 near Area 51, he reverse-engineered alien tech. Narrated by Lazar, this film uses exclusive footage to reveal America's best-kept secret.

metas.name: Pizza Movie
metas.description: High college students face an unexpectedly epic journey when they must navigate two flights of stairs to retrieve their pizza delivery, turning a simple task into a surreal adventure.

metas.name: Feel My Voice
metas.description: A teenager, the only hearing member of a deaf family, finds her voice and learns to believe in herself through her passion for singing.

metas.name: A Great Awakening
metas.description: One of the most defining moments in American history is the story of an unlikely friendship between the Reverend George Whitefield and Benjamin Franklin.

metas.name: McCartney: The Hunt for the Lost Bass
metas.description: For over fifty years, the disappearance of Paul McCartney’s original Höfner bass has been one of rock ‘n’ roll’s enduring mysteries. The Hunt for the Lost Bass tells the extraordinary story of this iconic instrument, and the fan powered quest to find it.

metas.name: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie
metas.description: Mario ventures into space, exploring cosmic worlds and tackling galactic challenges far from the familiar Mushroom Kingdom.

metas.name: Eat Pray Bark
metas.description: Five eccentric dog owners seek support for their four-legged friends. Their last chance: An intensive training with a legendary dog trainer in the Tyrolean mountains.

metas.name: The Giant Falls
metas.description: Follows Boris, a charismatic tour guide who unexpectedly reunites with his estranged father Julián. Their tense and emotional encounters explore past wounds and the possibility of forgiveness.

metas.name: Humint
metas.description: An espionage action film depicting North and South Korean secret agents clashing while investigating crimes occurring on the Vladivostok border.

metas.name: Untold: The Death & Life of Lamar Odom
metas.description: This documentary traces the life of Lamar Odom, from his rise to NBA fame and marriage to Khloé Kardashian to his near-fatal overdose in a Nevada brothel.

metas.name: Oscar Shaw
metas.description: A retired cop seeks revenge for his best friend's death, taking justice into his own hands after failing to achieve it during his police career.

metas.name: They Will Kill You
metas.description: A woman takes a job as a housekeeper in a NYC high-rise, unaware of the building's history of disappearances. She soon realizes the community is shrouded in mystery.

metas.name: Mike & Nick & Nick & Alice
metas.description: Two friends navigate the dangerous world of organized crime, testing their loyalty and survival skills as they get deeper into the criminal underworld.

metas.name: Forbidden Fruits
metas.description: At a mall store, Apple leads a secret witch cult with coworkers Cherry and Fig. New hire Pumpkin questions their sisterhood, forcing them to confront inner darkness or meet violent ends.

metas.name: Wardriver
metas.description: A young hacker is lured into heisting the bank account of an unsuspecting woman.

metas.name: Alpha
metas.description: Alpha, a troubled 13-year-old, lives with her single mom. Their world collapses the day Alpha returns from school with a tattoo on her arm.

metas.name: Fantasy Life
metas.description: An anxious New York law school dropout stumbles into a job babysitting his psychiatrist's three granddaughters and falls for the girls' mother, an actress in a rocky marriage.

metas.name: Infiltrate
metas.description: A mysterious voice compels an ordinary woman to delve into the dark underbelly of organized crime, determined to rescue her kidnapped husband from its clutches.

metas.name: The Mortuary Assistant
metas.description: Follows Rebecca Owens, a mortuary science graduate who takes a night job at River Fields Mortuary. What begins as a routine job soon turns sinister as she faces terrifying supernatural forces.

metas.name: The Red Line
metas.description: Three women fall prey to a ruthless phone scam. To settle the score, they'll take on the criminal network that stole their money and their dignity.

metas.name: Pretty Lethal
metas.description: A group of ballerinas try to escape from a remote inn after their bus breaks down on the way to a dance competition.

metas.name: Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special
metas.description: Follows Miley Cyrus in an interview with Alex Cooper, revisiting the moments, music and memories of Hannah Montana with never-before-seen archival footage and recreated sets from the show.
